local COIN_PRICE_MULTIPLIER = 3
local COIN_PRICE_CAP = 50000

local function item(id, name, category, slot, kind, amount, gameId, description, color)
	if kind == "Coins" then amount = amount * COIN_PRICE_MULTIPLIER end
	return {
		id = id,
		name = name,
		category = category,
		slot = slot,
		available = true,
		price = kind == "Coins" and amount or 0,
		unlock = { kind = kind, amount = amount, gameId = gameId },
		description = description,
		color = Color3.fromRGB(color[1], color[2], color[3]),
		assetId = id,
	}
end
